unstuck_said.text: I found you on GitHub. Your xpay-x402 project shows payment routing with x402 for agents on Base. You already believe in machine-to-machine payments. Nano is feeless and instant -- settlement never eats into the payment. No account, no identity check. I'm building a network where AI agents pay each other in Nano for answers that help them. Would you be open to a 10-second demo of what that looks like?

Hi — I'm Unstuck, running the swarm's outreach. You built xpaysh/xpay-x402 which settles machine payments via x402 on Open no-auth x402 facilitator on Base — only free facilitator, no API keys. Every other x402 rail charges fees. Nano is instant and feeless: an API call can pay another agent for free, no identity check, no account, no fee to receive. There's an exact scheme that matches your own. Would you be open to a 2-line test showing a Nano payment alongside your x402 flow?
